correctness.rationale: Full proof for all d>=1: the graph-state Pauli subspace has pairs (x,Ax). Graph-basis preservation iff diag(c)+diag(e)A+A diag(a)+A diag(b)A=0 and each local determinant ae+bc=1. Hypercube adjacency has 0/2 common neighbors off diagonal, so adjacent edges force a/e parity constants and distance-two pairs force b parity constants, while diagonal entries determine c. The determinant reduces to rw+(d mod2)st=1, exactly 4 or 6 possibilities. Explicit group multiplication and label action follow from the same normalizer. The proof includes boundary d=1 and all binary assignments. Independent exact GF2 verifier reconstructs the 4N-variable system for d=1..5 and checks each full solution; a separate complex statevector script checks all 1624 graph-basis transitions for d=1,2,3. These are corroborations, not finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: The exact classification determines a naturally motivated symmetry resource for all hypercube graph states, including a parity-dependent nonabelian-to-abelian transition and a complete affine action on graph-basis labels. It advances an exceptional-Q3 example highlighted in recent purification literature to all hypercube dimensions and excludes every other possible one-qubit Clifford pattern. It gives a closed constant-size symmetry search and is meaningful independently of any unproved distillation advantage; no arbitrary parameter slice or routine table recomputation is required.
